conceptual assets.information: The debug authorization state is the one-bit value presented on wdata_i(0) when written and retained in authenticated_q; debug access validity depends on this state. It leaves through valid_o.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The authorization state is security-sensitive and is exposed directly through valid_o at line 66. authenticated_q can be reset or overwritten through the assignments at lines 51-57. Clearing authenticated_q when enable_i is low at lines 54-55 deasserts valid_o at line 66 and can disable authentication-dependent debug operation. The unchecked write path lets wdata_i(0) directly establish the authorization state at lines 56-57, allowing an authentication bypass and an incorrect valid_o result.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could observe valid_o, assert we_i with wdata_i(0) set to one to gain authorization, or force enable_i low to clear authorization and disrupt debug operation.

conceptual assets.information: The authentication update command is the write request that permits the presented value to change the debug authentication state. Debug authentication establishment depends on this command.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Changing we_i changes whether authenticated_q is overwritten by wdata_i(0) at lines 56-57, so an unauthorized write request can alter authorization. Withholding we_i prevents the authentication state from being established from wdata_i at lines 56-57, blocking the authentication operation.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could assert we_i with an attacker-selected authentication value or suppress it so that legitimate authentication cannot complete.

conceptual assets.information: The authentication enable decision controls whether the authentication state may remain active or is cleared. The debug authentication function depends on this control.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Changing enable_i changes authenticated_q through the clear assignment selected at lines 54-55, allowing the authentication behavior to be altered. Driving enable_i low clears authenticated_q at lines 54-55 and consequently blocks the valid_o indication at line 66.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could force enable_i low to clear the authentication state and prevent the debugger from operating as intended.

considered, not kept.reason: re_i is only declared at line 26 and is never read, so it is not used to carry or control information in this unit.
rdata_o is assigned only constant zeros at line 69 and therefore carries no variable or security-relevant information.
busy_o is tied to constant zero at line 63 and does not represent a changing state or functional status.
clk_i only times the authenticated_q process at lines 49-53, and clock inputs are excluded from conceptual assets.
rstn_i only resets authenticated_q at lines 51-52, and reset inputs are excluded from conceptual assets.
